text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Hmm, my Bakushin energy is particularly strong on my days off. I accidentally ran to the border of the prefecture…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Oh! Right on schedule, my rival!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: A bullet train! As expected! What performance! Running at such speeds!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: …But I won't lose! I'll show you the fruits of my training!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant… No way. How could I… lose sight of it…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Where… where did I end up?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: By the time Sakura Bakushin O makes it back to Tracen Academy, she's completely exhausted.
